manual.title: Manual for Drought Management (updated 2020)
manual.publisher: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India

rules.trigger1Route: gauge rainfall deviation (Table 3.1 classes) with dry spells; SPI route reported beside it
rules.severity: severe: two or more severe and the third at least moderate; moderate: two or more at least moderate; otherwise normal
interpretations: 'Moderate' in the severity rule is read as 'moderate or worse'.
Hydrology bands mild and extreme (Tables 3.8, 3.9) are folded into normal and severe.
The first week of June precedes the monsoon's normal onset over most of the state and is not counted toward a dry spell.
GWDI's mean depth is read as the mean for the same month across the record.

rain.source: AP DES mandal rain gauges via APWRIMS
rain.note: Weekly totals are differences between the portal's season-to-date figures at successive week ends.

spi.product: CHIRPS v3.0 monthly, zonal mean per mandal boundary

vci.product: NOAA STAR Blended Vegetation Health Product (VIIRS), VCI, 4 km weekly
vci.caveat: 4 km cells over all vegetation, not cropland alone; the manual prefers 56-500 m NDVI/NDWI over agricultural areas. A screening value, not a declaration-grade one.

pasm.source: NRSC VIC land-surface model via APWRIMS, plant-available water at 30 cm

gwdi.source: APWRIMS monthly groundwater depth, the site's own mandal series
gwdi.rule: same calendar month in every year on record, at least 10 years

rsi.source: APWRIMS reservoir storage, the same date in each of the last ten years

sowing.source: Commissionerate of Agriculture, Andhra Pradesh: Season and Crop Coverage Report
sowing.note: The department's weekly report as quoted in the press, entered by hand. The department publishes it on apagrisnet.gov.in, which did not answer automated requests made from outside India on 2026-10-03, so the weekly refresh cannot read it. Only five districts were quoted. Replace with the department's own district and mandal figures when they are shared.
